LESSON: MSAMIATI.

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Msamiati.

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Msamiati.. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua msamiati ambao unahusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na uzalendo ili kujenga usomaji
3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
4. kutumia msamiati wa uzalendo katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha uandishi bora f) kuthamini uzalendo ili kuwa mzalendo kwa nchi yake. 82 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua msamiati ambao unahusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutambua msamiati ambao unahusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na uzalendo ili kujenga usomaji
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na uzalendo ili kujenga usomaji. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kutumia msamiati wa uzalendo katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha uandishi bora f) kuthamini uzalendo ili kuwa mzalendo kwa nchi yake. 82 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia msamiati wa uzalendo katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha uandishi bora f) kuthamini uzalendo ili kuwa mzalendo kwa nchi yake. 82 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Msamiati..
2. Explain Msamiati. to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Msamiati..
4. Show that you can: kutambua msamiati ambao unahusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Msamiati.. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Msamiati. important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua msamiati ambao unahusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma msamiati unaohusiana na uzalendo ili kujenga usomaji
3. kueleza maana ya msamiati wa uzalendo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
4. kutumia msamiati wa uzalendo katika sentensi sahihi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuandika maneno yanayohusiana na uzalendo ili kuimarisha uandishi bora f) kuthamini uzalendo ili kuwa mzalendo kwa nchi yake. 82 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
